mapper.sql: select id, user_id, order_no, status, product_type, product_id, product_name, purchase_mode, activity_id, original_amount, discount_amount, payable_amount, points_amount, points_deduct_amount, coupon_id, created_time, paid_time, close_time, updated_time, delete_flag from osh_order
mapper.insert: insert into osh_order ( user_id, order_no, status, product_type, product_id, product_name, purchase_mode, activity_id, original_amount, discount_amount, payable_amount, points_amount, points_deduct_amount, coupon_id, created_time, paid_time, close_time, updated_time, delete_flag ) values ( #{userId}, #{orderNo}, #{status}, #{productType}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{purchaseMode}, #{activityId}, #{originalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payableAmount}, #{pointsAmount}, #{pointsDeductAmount}, #{couponId}, #{createdTime}, #{paidTime}, #{closeTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{deleteFlag} )
mapper.update: update osh_order set status = 1, paid_time = #{paidTime}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 0
update osh_order set status = 2, close_time = #{closeTime}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 1 or o.paid_time is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as paidOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 0 and coalesce(p.status, -1) != 1 and o.paid_time is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as closedOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 2 and coalesce(p.status, -1) != 1 and o.paid_time is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as canceledOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 1 or o.paid_time is not null then coalesce(p.amount, o.payable_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as paidAmount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 0 and coalesce(p.status, -1) != 1 and o.paid_time is null then o.payable_amount else 0 end), 0) as pendingAmount, coalesce(sum(o.points_deduct_amount), 0) as pointsDeductAmount from osh_order o left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where

select date_format(o.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 1 or o.paid_time is not null then coalesce(p.amount, o.payable_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as cashAmount, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 1 or o.paid_time is not null then o.points_deduct_amount else 0 end), 0) as pointsDeductAmount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 0 and coalesce(p.status, -1) != 1 and o.paid_time is null then o.payable_amount else 0 end), 0) as pendingAmount, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 1 or o.paid_time is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as paidOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 0 and coalesce(p.status, -1) != 1 and o.paid_time is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingOrderCount from osh_order o left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where group by date_format(o.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day asc

select cast(p.channel as char) as payType, count(1) as count, coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) as amount from osh_order o inner join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 and p.status = 1 where group by p.channel order by count desc, p.channel asc

select count(distinct o.id) as createdCount, count(distinct p.id) as paymentCreatedCount, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 1 or o.paid_time is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as paidCount from osh_order o left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where

select coalesce(sum(o.points_deduct_amount), 0) as deductAmount, coalesce(sum(o.points_amount), 0) as usedPoints, case when count(1) = 0 then 0 else round(sum(case when o.points_amount > 0 then 1 else 0 end) * 100 / count(1), 2) end as usageRate from osh_order o where

select o.product_type as productType, coalesce(sum(o.points_amount), 0) as usedPoints, coalesce(sum(o.points_deduct_amount), 0) as deductAmount from osh_order o where and o.points_amount > 0 group by o.product_type order by usedPoints desc

select o.product_name as productName, o.product_type as productType, count(1) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 1 or o.paid_time is not null then coalesce(p.amount, o.payable_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as paidAmount, coalesce(sum(o.points_deduct_amount), 0) as pointsDeductAmount from osh_order o left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where group by o.product_name, o.product_type order by paidAmount desc, orderCount desc limit 10

select coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 0 and o.created_time <= #{timeoutTime} and coalesce(p.status, -1) != 1 and o.paid_time is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as timeoutPendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when p.id is not null and p.amount != o.payable_amount then 1 else 0 end), 0) as amountMismatchCount, coalesce(sum(case when p.status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as paymentFailedCount from osh_order o left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where

select count(1) from osh_order o left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where and o.status = 0 and o.paid_time is null and coalesce(p.status, -1) != 1 and o.created_time <= #{timeoutTime}

select o.id, o.user_id as userId, u.username, o.order_no as orderNo, o.status, o.product_type as productType, o.product_id as productId, o.product_name as productName, o.original_amount as originalAmount, o.discount_amount as discountAmount, o.payable_amount as payableAmount, o.points_amount as pointsAmount, o.points_deduct_amount as pointsDeductAmount, p.payment_no as paymentNo, p.channel as payChannel, p.status as paymentStatus, o.created_time as createdTime, o.paid_time as paidTime, o.close_time as closeTime from osh_order o left join osh_user u on u.id = o.user_id and u.delete_flag = 0 left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where order by o.created_time desc, o.id desc

select o.id, o.user_id as userId, u.username, o.order_no as orderNo, o.status, o.product_type as productType, o.product_id as productId, o.product_name as productName, o.original_amount as originalAmount, o.discount_amount as discountAmount, o.payable_amount as payableAmount, o.points_amount as pointsAmount, o.points_deduct_amount as pointsDeductAmount, p.payment_no as paymentNo, p.channel as payChannel, p.status as paymentStatus, o.created_time as createdTime, o.paid_time as paidTime, o.close_time as closeTime from osh_order o left join osh_user u on u.id = o.user_id and u.delete_flag = 0 left join osh_payment p on p.order_no = o.order_no and p.delete_flag = 0 where o.order_no = #{orderNo} and o.delete_flag = 0 limit 1

select p.order_no as orderNo, p.payment_no as paymentNo, p.channel, p.amount, p.status, p.platform_trade_no as platformTradeNo, p.pay_url as payUrl, p.qrcode, p.paid_time as paidTime, p.expire_time as expireTime, p.created_time as createdTime from osh_payment p where p.order_no = #{orderNo} and p.delete_flag = 0 order by p.created_time desc, p.id desc limit 1

select l.payment_no as paymentNo, l.order_no as orderNo, l.platform_trade_no as platformTradeNo, l.sign_valid as signValid, l.process_status as processStatus, l.error_msg as errorMsg, l.created_time as createdTime from osh_payment_notify_log l where l.order_no = #{orderNo} order by l.created_time desc, l.id desc limit 20
